items.problem: The result of a throw of the change function of `run_user_transaction` is not defined. storage.md:94 and 140 define a throw for `run_game_transaction` and `run_request_transaction` (rolls back and throws), and storage.md:193 defines it only for the apply function and fail function of a user change (handled as `FAILED`). ranking.md:164 requires that a throw of its change function makes that handling `FAILED`, while routing.md:74 says `dev` throws when the operation throws, without saying what `run_user_transaction` does. An implementation that rethrows and one that returns `FAILED` both fit this text and give different results in callers that only handle `FAILED`

When PostgreSQL aborts a transaction (`40P01`/`40001`) during a query other than `lock_game_row`, the spec says only that storage "rolls back the transaction, and the operation that opened that transaction is `FAILED`". It does not say what the synchronous `query` method of storage.md:97, still running inside the change, request or game function, does at that point: throw, or return. It also does not say what later queries on that aborted transaction do. An implementation in which `query` returns lets the function continue on a dead transaction. An implementation in which `query` throws lets content or core code catch the exception. Both fit the text, and they give different control flow inside handlers and hooks

The storage spec does not say that `lock_game_row` on PostgreSQL takes a transaction advisory lock, nor how the int64 lock key is made from the table name and key value (the only advisory lock in this spec is the schema lock at :264, keyed by "one constant of the core code"). skills/server-core/modules/testing.md:105 `game_row_lock_id` and :134 `hold_lock_key` require that lock and key, and the tests at storage.md:421, :423, :424 and matchmaker.md:380-381 use them. Nothing sets that a game row key cannot equal the schema lock constant or the key of a row of another table, so a collision is not excluded and can serialize unrelated rows or make a game row lock wait for server start
